files.content:
- moriodata:
    info: "Collects metrics from Linux systems"
    vars:
      METRICS_LINUX_SYSTEM_INTERVAL_FILESYSTEM:
        dflt: 10m
        info: The interval to use for collecting filesystem data
      METRICS_LINUX_SYSTEM_METRICSETS_ALWAYS:
        dflt:
          - cpu
          - diskio
          - load
          - memory
          - service
          - network_summary
          - process_summary
          - socket_summary
        info: The metricsets to collect on every tick
      METRICS_LINUX_SYSTEM_MOUNTPOINTS_IGNORE_REGEX:
        dflt: '^/(snap|sys|cgroup|proc|dev|host|lib)($|/)'
        info: A regular expression of mountpoints for which to drop filesystem events

- module: system
  period: "{| MORIO_TICK |}"
  metricsets: {|{ METRICS_LINUX_SYSTEM_METRICSETS_ALWAYS }|}
  service:
    state_filter: [ failed ]

- module: system
  period: {| METRICS_LINUX_SYSTEM_INTERVAL_FILESYSTEM |}
  metricsets:
    - fsstat
  processors:
    - drop_event:
        when:
          regexp:
            system.filesystem.mount_point: {|{ METRICS_LINUX_SYSTEM_MOUNTPOINTS_IGNORE_REGEX }|}

# noop
#
# Filebeat does not list inputs as modules.
# So we keep an empty file here to make sure this shows up as a Filebeat module.
#

- moriodata:
    info: "Collects log data from journald on Linux systems"

- type: journald # This collects all journald data
  id: journald_everything
  processors:
    - decode_json_fields:
        fields: ["message"]
        process_array: false
        max_depth: 2
        target: "message_json"
        overwrite_keys: false
        add_error_key: false

- moriodata:
    info: "Auditd rules for Linux"
    vars:
      AUDIT_LINUX_SYSTEM_RULE_FILES:
        dflt:
- /etc/morio/audit/rules.d/linux-system-morio.rules
          - /etc/morio/audit/rules.d/linux-system-mitre.rules
info: A list of files with auditd rules to load

- module: auditd
  audit_rule_files: {|{ AUDIT_LINUX_SYSTEM_RULE_FILES }|}
  ignore_errors: false

- module: system
  datasets:
    - login
    - user
  period: 300s
  state.period: 8h
  login.wtmp_file_pattern: /var/log/wtmp*
  login.btmp_file_pattern: /var/log/btmp*
  user.detect_password_changes: true
